tutorial: No FreeCAD wiki tutorial covers ScanRuler's Reverse engineer (Stefan Hermann's / CNC Kitchen's feature engine, ported onto Part / OCCT). The model rebuilds the simplest tutorial-style part — a block with a bored hole and rounded upright edges, as PartDesign's Basic_Part_Design_Tutorial.md builds one with Pad, Pocket and Fillet — through the feature list, so every volume has a worked-out answer; then a second body, a clearance, an imported STEP gauge block and a revolved ring.

expected.ids: In a fresh document the features get ids 1 to 11 in the order added (a refused call uses none): Base sketch 1, Block 2, Hole sketch 3, Bore 4, Round 5, Peg sketch 6, Peg 7, Seat dowel 8, gauge 9, Ring sketch 10, Ring 11.
expected.where: The argument shapes, ids, refusals and parameter answers were run in plain Python on the add-on's stand-in kernel on this pass; the volumes are worked out by hand. No geometry ran: the kernel is FreeCAD's Part.

conventions.session: A fresh document: the ids above depend on it. Run the chunks in order.
conventions.health: Every changing reverse_ call carries health; it is red when a feature failed (the add-on's own reading, new on this pass). Expected green throughout.
conventions.references: No placeholders: call 20 takes the four upright edges from call 19's answer ({ $from: 19, $at: "edges.0" } … edges 1, 4, 7) and call 36 the moved body's id from call 35's ({ $from: 35, $at: "added.0.bodies.0" }); n is the call's index in this whole list (agentlink/chain.py). Each reaches one call back, so a batch answered in parts keeps each pair together.

notCovered: feature kinds beyond sketch, extrude, revolve, fillet, moveBody and import (chamfer, shell, hole, thread, draft, pattern, mirror, boolean, cutPlane, loft, sweep, the surface kinds): each needs picks or planes whose record shapes were not checked on this pass — reverse_feature_schema gives them
sketches on a section's or a measured plane, extract, surface, network, trim, split: they need a scan with sections and elements (the other ScanRuler agent's families)

a build slow enough to matter, and a failing feature (health red): set Round's radius to 30 with reverse_feature_update to see one

reverse_build_stop answering anything but its refusal: the tool is always refused in this port by design (builds run inside FreeCAD's own process; its description says so), so no call of it can succeed — call 45's refusal, with the three tools it names, is all there is to prove
